mechanism: Acyclovir may increase haloperidol levels through competitive renal tubular secretion and potential CNS effects, while haloperidol may lower seizure threshold in patients receiving acyclovir at high doses.
action: Monitor for haloperidol toxicity (extrapyramidal symptoms, tardive dyskinesia) and acyclovir neurotoxicity (confusion, hallucinations, seizures); ensure adequate renal function and consider dose adjustments if needed.
